title: AI ALIGNMENT THROUGH REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FROM HUMAN FEEDBACK? CONTRADICTIONS AND LIMITATIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative sociotechnical critique analyzing how RLHF and RLAIF frameworks risk imposing hegemonic (often Western) values, leading to cultural homogenization and the marginalization of non-dominant societal norms.

Conceptual analysis evaluating how alignment criteria in RLxF fine-tuning flatten linguistic diversity by optimizing for hegemonic language uses, thereby excluding or underserving non-dominant language speakers.
